André Is an Idiot(2025) is a Sundance Audience Award winning documentary about André Ricciardi, a wildly funny and unapologetically honest man who turns his own Stage 4 colon cancer diagnosis into a remarkable story about laughter, life, and facing mortality with irreverence.

This is a film that manages to make you laugh out loud and tear up in the same breath. Critics have praised it as “funny, sad, and surprisingly heartfelt,” a movie that uses humor and heart to explore something deeply human and universal.

The pacing feels just right, the tone balances comedy with sincere reflection, and by the end you come away feeling deeply connected to André and his family. For anyone who loves movies that are smart, weird, and genuinely moving, this one is worth your time.
